section_sequence.what_it_does: A black 'Clerk raises $50m Series C' strip above a rounded, bordered pill nav with dropdowns and Sign in/Sign up.
A two-line heavy headline and a two-line grey dek over a faint circuit-line background, ending in a 'Build with agents' tab attached to a copyable monospace prompt field.
A 'Trusted by fast-growing companies' label in a left cell, then four bordered logo cells in a row.
Left: headline, copy and an accordion (User Authentication / Multi-tenancy / Billing) listing component tags. Right: a live-looking 'Create your account' sign-in card with faded ghost UIs around it.

A black band entered through a notched trapezoid edge, with a centered headline and a bento grid of dark feature tiles (MFA, fraud, session, SSO, bot detection, passwords, API keys, CLI), each with a small illustration.
A notched exit back to light; left-aligned headline, then three white cards (roles, auto-join, org components) with avatar and UI vignettes.
Copy with a checklist on the left; a mock 'Tailor made pricing from Acme, Inc.' pricing table in a browser frame on the right.
A notched black band with two centered sub-headlines side by side, each over a grid of outlined framework/integration icons.
'Trusted around the world' copy on the left beside a two-column masonry of tweet-style quote cards; one large quote below the copy.
Logo plus five link columns (Product, SDKs, Resources, Company, Legal), with copyright and social icons below.

motion.observed: The logo cells swap sets (inngest/durable/upstash/Cartesia → David AI/OpenRouter/samaya/Consensus → Browserbase/braintrust/Higgsfield…). At 8s the cells are mid-swap, with outgoing and incoming logos stacked vertically.
The card fills itself in: the email field shows 'chris.walker@example.com' and a pointer sits on the password field, then the Continue button (inferred: a scripted typing and cursor demo).
The notched dark bands slide in as ordinary page content; no pinning or scrubbing is visible.

reduced_motion: No visible layout difference in the hero; the logo band shows the first set. capture.json running_animations is 3 normally but 5 with reduced motion, so the preference does not reduce motion here.
mobile: The announcement bar scrolls away; the pill nav (logo, Sign in, Sign up, hamburger) stays pinned. The headline wraps to four centered lines, and the agent prompt field truncates. The logo band becomes a centered caption over a 2×2 rotating grid. In Components the sign-in card moves above the accordion. The bento tiles, cards and pricing mock go to one column, and framework/integration icons become a labeled 2-column grid. The testimonials stack, and a floating round Clerk button stays at bottom right.
adaptable_ideas: Alternate light and dark bands joined by a notched trapezoid edge, so the section changes read as one continuous chassis.
Make the primary hero CTA a copyable one-line agent prompt in a monospace field with a tab label, instead of a button.
Show the product itself as the section illustration (a real sign-in card or pricing table), surrounded by faded ghost variants for depth.
Put the logo band in bordered cells that rotate sets in place, so many customers are shown without a scrolling marquee.
capture_issues: mobile-full is clipped at 14,000px, partway through the footer (Legal column).
desktop-full paints the sticky nav over the testimonials section, and mobile-full paints it over the footer.
The desktop recording jumps back to the hero once mid-scroll before continuing.
